o: When Owen shows up after five years on the run, Hannah and her stepdaughter Bailey find themselves in a race to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them.

v.n: Who Said It? - Behind the Scenes

eps.o: After five happy years in Los Angeles, Hannah and Bailey find themselves on the run from a familiar threat.
An old friend shows up with news about Owen and a dire warning. Meanwhile, sinister forces are hot on Bailey and Hannah's trail.
An emotional family reunion brings unexpected revelations for Hannah. Grady continues to gather evidence.
The Michaels travel to Austin to confront their problem head on, unaware of what awaits them.
While her parents follow a lead in Houston, Bailey reconnects with her late mother's best friend.
Hannah and Owen take their search for answers abroad while Bailey makes a shocking discovery about her mother.
All roads lead to Paris for a long-awaited confrontation with the crime family patriarch.
When all seems lost, Bailey's relentless search for the truth might uncover a way out—and finally set her family free.
